dct_description_sm: The first spatially-enhanced MODIS clear-sky mosaic for the Arctic circumpolar zone (9,000 km  9,000 km) is generated, as contribution to the Canadian component of the International Polar Year (IPY) Program. The major intended application of the new data is mapping the surface albedo at 250 m spatial resolution. This product in turn can be used as an input for generating several other essential climate variables (ECVs) as defined by Global Climate Observing System (GCOS)
dct_title_s: Arctic circumpolar clear-sky mosaic at 250m spatial resolution produced from MODIS/TERRA land bands B1-B7
